purpose: Represent where a product offer can physically originate, with evidence and precision separate from merchant legal identity.

supplier_location.location_type: factory | warehouse | distributor | dealer | store | batching_plant | nursery | unknown
supplier_location.precision: exact | postcode | city | province | region | country | unknown

verification.source_type: merchant_api | manufacturer | distributor | carrier | public_business_record | merchant_website | catalog_filter | manual | unknown

project_relation.tier: local | regional | national | eu | global | unknown

principles: Merchant HQ is not assumed to be fulfillment origin.
A Shopify ships_from country filter verifies country-level origin only; it does not establish city, warehouse, or project distance.
Distance ranking requires a geocoded fulfillment, factory, dealer, or distributor location with evidence.
Concrete and other radius-bound products may rank from batching plant/service-area location rather than merchant headquarters.
